_comment: Hand-written CarouselSourceContext for `cli.py carousel research --fixture <this file>`. Use it for offline walks of the pipeline. The facts must be ones a human actually read in the source — the factory never invents them, and a fixture full of invented claims defeats the point of the fact guard. Keys must match CarouselSourceContext in core/models.py; extra keys are ignored, and a shape drift fails loudly in `model_validate`.
title: Short title of the source
summary: One or two sentences describing what the source says.
facts: A statement the source literally supports.
A second statement the source literally supports.

sourced_facts.text: A statement the source literally supports.
